name: Case 3 · The Workshop
blurb: Portside, heavy rain. Three specialists, one hidden workshop inside a container stack. Act 1 finale.

lines.text: Juno breaks into INTERCEPT's own network live, on the projector, to prove it leaks. The whole squad is watching.
"I installed your Sightline this morning. Fixed three CVEs while I was in there. You're welcome."
"Third victim. Port dispatcher, Tobi Lawal. Gone since the night shift. Same kite left on his desk. Move."

scenes.title: They planted something. Read past it.
scenes.sentence: The hostages are at ___ because of ___ and ___.

scenes.brief: Juno's drone (EYE) confirms one route. Spool is driving between the yard and the workshop.

scenes.win_text: A container drops into your lane and you drift beneath it as it lands. Spool bails into the stack on foot.

scenes.prompt: Three hostages chained to benches. The server wipe bar is climbing.

left.label: Save all three hostages
left.result: You get all three out. The drive finishes wiping behind you.
left.echo: The Keys are lost. You will have to rebuild the plan from the city itself.

right.label: Grab the drive
right.result: You pull the drive with 4% left to wipe. A crane lifts Funmi's container away as you do.
right.echo: You hold part of the Keys. Funmi is recovered at the start of Case 4.

hesitate.label: You hesitated
hesitate.result: Sol makes the call for you and goes for the hostages. The drive wipes clean.
hesitate.echo: Both of them noticed who decided.

scenes.win_text: The gantry remote shatters. Spool is cuffed on the walkway, rain running off him.
scenes.lose_text: A container slams down between you. You still get him — it is just louder, and the port will be talking about it.

scenes.title: Act 1 · The Kites
scenes.text: The victims explain what they were forced to build, together called the Keys: every bridge's structural weak points, a backdoor into traffic control, and the port's customs blind spots.
scenes.cliff: Spool leans to the glass: "Never saw the client. We got paid in maps. The Cartographer says hello, Rook."
scenes.cta: End of Act I skeleton — Act II is next
